structure_type: <str> Identifier for the truss topology used in this instance.
dimension: <int> Number of spatial dimensions of the truss (2 for planar, 3 for space trusses).
num_bars: <int> Total number of bars in the truss structure.
num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the truss structure, including supports.
num_loading_conditions: <int> Number of independent external loading conditions the structure must withstand.
num_free_dofs: <int> Number of unconstrained nodal displacement directions across all free nodes.
num_linking_groups: <int> Number of groups of symmetrically located bars that must share the same cross-sectional area.
linking_groups: <list[dict], length num_linking_groups> Groups of bars required to receive identical cross-sectional areas due to structural symmetry.

nodes.is_support: <bool> Whether this node is a fixed support with no freedom of movement.
nodes.fixed_dofs: <list[str]> Coordinate directions in which this support node is fixed (present only for support nodes).

bars.node_i: <int> Node at the start end of the bar.
bars.node_j: <int> Node at the finish end of the bar.
bars.length: <float> Physical length of the bar computed from node coordinates.
bars.direction_cosines: <list[float], length dimension> Cosines of the angle between the bar's orientation and each coordinate axis.

degrees_of_freedom.dof_id: <int> Unique identifier for this degree of freedom.
degrees_of_freedom.node: <int> Node to which this degree of freedom belongs.
degrees_of_freedom.direction: <str> Coordinate direction of this degree of freedom.

material_properties.modulus_of_elasticity: <float> Young's modulus of the bar material, relating stress to strain.
material_properties.cost_density: <float> Cost per unit volume used to compute the total structural cost.

discrete_areas: <list[float], length num_discrete_areas> Candidate cross-sectional areas from which exactly one must be chosen for each bar.
num_discrete_areas: <int> Number of candidate cross-sectional areas available for selection.

stress_bounds.lower: <float> Default minimum allowable stress in any bar (negative denotes compression).
stress_bounds.upper: <float> Default maximum allowable stress in any bar (positive denotes tension).

bar_specific_stress_bounds.bar_id: <int> Bar to which these stress limits apply.
bar_specific_stress_bounds.lower: <float> Minimum allowable stress for this bar.
bar_specific_stress_bounds.upper: <float> Maximum allowable stress for this bar.

displacement_bounds.lower: <float or null> Minimum allowable nodal displacement at any free degree of freedom, or null if unbounded.
displacement_bounds.upper: <float or null> Maximum allowable nodal displacement at any free degree of freedom, or null if unbounded.

loading_conditions.load_id: <int> Unique identifier for this loading condition.
loading_conditions.description: <str> Human-readable summary of the applied loads.

loads.node: <int> Node at which this external force is applied.
loads.direction: <str> Coordinate direction of the applied force.
loads.dof_id: <int> Degree of freedom at which the force acts.
loads.force: <float> Magnitude and sign of the applied external force.

expected_optimal_mass: <float> Known best objective value for this instance from the literature.
